summary: The ultimate skin-mimic tool. A hydrophilic, latex-free sponge that doubles in size when wet to bounce foundation into a seamless, poreless finish.
description: Aqueous application engineering. When saturated, water fills the micro-pores of the sponge, ensuring your expensive liquid foundations sit entirely on the surface rather than being absorbed into the core.
technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 1 Unit, this KoColor SPONGES is expertly formulated with Hydrophilic Polyurethane Foam. It delivers a high-fidelity Aesthetic Pink color profile (`#FFB6C1`) and leverages aqueous-saturation displacement.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Fully submerge in water and squeeze repeatedly until expanded. Wring out all excess water forcefully before use.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Use the damp sponge to press in your final layer of translucent setting powder to eliminate any residual powdery or "cakey" texture.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Strictly latex-free to prevent common dermal contact allergies and ensure a softer, more pliable bounce coefficient.
